name: AI Meeting Notepad
author: jlopezxs
description: Granola-style meeting notes: capture desktop and mic audio, transcribe locally with Voxtype, optional AI summaries via your default Omarchy agent.

barWidget.description: Record meetings, live transcript, AI summary, and Q&A over your notes

schema.label: Meetings per page
schema.description: How many meetings to show per page in the list. Use the arrows to see older meetings.

schema.label: Notes folder
schema.description: Where meeting markdown is stored. Default: ~/.local/state/omarchy/meetings/

schema.label: Default language
schema.description: Whisper language for meetings. Use es/en for Spanish/English video or calls — avoids English hallucinations on non-English audio.

schema.label: AI summaries
schema.description: Send transcripts to your default Omarchy agent for live and final summaries. That agent may use a remote provider. Off by default. Capture and transcripts stay local either way.

schema.label: Summary preprompt
schema.description: Extra instructions prepended to the AI summary prompt. Only used when AI summaries are on.

schema.label: Chunk duration (seconds)
schema.description: Written to Voxtype meeting config when a session starts.

schema.label: Keep raw audio
schema.description: Retain Voxtype meeting audio files after transcription.

schema.label: Auto-enable Voxtype meeting mode
schema.description: Ensure [meeting] is enabled in ~/.config/voxtype/config.toml before recording.
